Combined with 6-21G+(d,p) thermal data: dG_hyd = -0.74 kcal/mol (0K, elec+ZPE), -2.35 kcal/mol (dH, 298K), but +9.42 kcal/mol (dG, 298K) -- badly wrong vs experimental -0.11 kcal/mol. -TdS = +11.8 kcal/mol, remarkably close to chloroacetaldehyde's own +11.9 kcal/mol artifact (see caa run_notes) -- strong, reproducible evidence the standalone water's ideal-gas translational entropy is systematically too high.
